conclusion: None of the tested Phase 6 interventions demonstrated a reliable improvement under the predefined temporal evaluation protocol.
interpretation_limit: The Phase 6 results do not establish that improvement is impossible; they apply to the tested, predeclared interventions and protocol.

protocol.selection: three forward-only temporal folds within the Phase 5.5 training partition
protocol.external_validation: one-time Phase 5.5 validation evaluation after temporal-CV selection

phases.hypothesis: Cost-sensitive learning improves Ponzi recall and F1 while preserving strong precision.
phases.intervention: Class weighting for Ridge/SVM and scale_pos_weight for XGBoost.
phases.temporal_cv_conclusion: No selected model-family variant met the predefined mean-CV precision floor; selections were diagnostic fallbacks.
phases.validation_conclusion: No selected variant improved frozen precision, recall, and F1; PR-AUC was lower for the reported selected variants.

phases.hypothesis: Controlled random under/over-sampling improves Ponzi recall and F1 while preserving useful precision.
phases.intervention: Training-only random under-sampling and random over-sampling.
phases.temporal_cv_conclusion: Only the selected SVM candidate met the CV precision criterion; CV evidence did not establish a reliable family-level improvement.
phases.validation_conclusion: Ridge and SVM matched frozen precision/recall/F1 but reduced PR-AUC; XGBoost reduced precision and F1.

phases.hypothesis: Temporal-CV classifier operating-threshold selection improves F1 and/or recall while maintaining useful precision.
phases.intervention: Native-score threshold selection from pooled temporal out-of-fold predictions.
phases.temporal_cv_conclusion: Ridge had no eligible threshold; eligible SVM/XGBoost thresholds achieved precision by sacrificing nearly all recall.
phases.validation_conclusion: Selected SVM/XGBoost thresholds predicted no positives; the Ridge fallback reduced precision and F1 despite higher recall.

phases.hypothesis: Compact opcode-sequence structural features improve the frozen static representations.
phases.intervention: Contract-local structural opcode counts, ratios, stack patterns, and complexity features.
phases.temporal_cv_conclusion: No representation met the mean-CV precision floor; reported selections were diagnostic fallbacks.
phases.validation_conclusion: Selected Ridge/SVM representations matched classification metrics but lowered PR-AUC; XGBoost selected the frozen control.

phases.hypothesis: Normalized operand-derived static features recover useful information discarded by opcode-only preprocessing.
phases.intervention: Normalized deployed-runtime PUSH operand volume, value-structure, width, and size-pattern features.
phases.temporal_cv_conclusion: No representation met the mean-CV precision floor; reported selections were diagnostic fallbacks.
phases.validation_conclusion: SVM/XGBoost width features matched classification metrics but lowered PR-AUC; operand-only Ridge degraded substantially.

phases.hypothesis: Selected alternative classifiers exploit frozen paper-aligned views more effectively.
phases.intervention: Logistic Regression and LightGBM on the five frozen Phase 5.5 feature views.
phases.temporal_cv_conclusion: Neither classifier family produced a candidate satisfying the mean-CV precision floor.
phases.validation_conclusion: Logistic Regression matched classification metrics but lowered PR-AUC; LightGBM raised precision slightly while lowering recall, F1, PR-AUC, and balanced accuracy.

phases.reason: Not executed because no independently supported intervention existed to combine.
